prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Controls & Voice Practice Screen: Insert a new onboarding screen before home intro showing interactive quick-reference buttons for hiding, summoning, and talking to the pet. (why: Support received 3 post-onboarding tickets indicating confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Reordering After Waiting Screen: Move sign-in after the waiting screen so users authenticate right before reaching the home intro screen. (why: Sign-in has long mean completion time (567s) and account linking right before desktop launch prevents drop-off during setup.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Upload Assistant Flow: Add a photo preparation guide screen right before photo upload detailing lighting and camera angles for optimal pet generation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step drop-off is high (60.9%).)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Auto-Recovery Hint: Add a visual safety hint on sign-in warning users to log in with their primary account to preserve previously saved pets. (why: 8 support emails were submitted regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again with a secondary account.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Choice Layout: Change the choose_path layout to two_column with side-by-side choice cards highlighting premade vs photo-generated pet options. (why: Choose path has a high mean duration (514s) and 76.2% conversion, showing user hesitation between paths.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Shortcut Guidance Copy: Update home_intro text to clearly detail hotkeys for hiding and summoning the pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion post-onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Introductory Screen Layout: Update the story screen layout to story_scroll with a animated mascot element introduce the app premise. (why: Early drop-off at choose_path (76.2% conversion) benefits from engaging visual onboarding storytelling.)
